title: Crafting Technique
description: Frontmatter schema for a single technique file under techniques/<category>/<id>.md. This is the structured half of the file; the markdown body below the frontmatter is the human-readable explanation and is not validated here.

id.description: Unique slug, matches the filename without extension.

name.description: Short human-readable name shown in docs/search results.

category.description: Top-level currency/system this technique belongs to.

action.description: What kind of transformation this technique performs on an item.

affects.description: Which mod slot types this technique can place outcomes into or remove from.

mod_pool_tags.description: Mod tags this technique can guarantee, bias toward, or restrict to (e.g. life, energy_shield, resistance, speed). Use ["any"] if the technique does not restrict by tag.

guarantee.description: How certain the tagged outcome is: 'guaranteed' (always get a mod matching mod_pool_tags), 'biased' (weighted toward it but not certain), or 'none' (fully random, mod_pool_tags is empty/any).

destructive.description: How much of the item's existing mod state this technique disturbs. 'none' only adds into an open slot. 'remove_one' removes exactly one existing mod (random or tag-targeted). 'reroll_all' clears and rerolls every mod at the item's rarity.

preconditions.description: Requirements the item must meet before this technique can be applied.

influence.description: Influence tag(s) the item must already have, if any (item needs at least one of these, i.e. OR semantics). Empty array = no influence required.

requires_open_affix.description: True if this technique needs an unused prefix or suffix slot to succeed (e.g. harvest augment).

requires_existing_mod_tag.description: Tags that must already be present on the item for this technique to make sense (e.g. eldritch reroll requires an existing eldritch implicit).

cost_tier.description: Rough relative currency cost, for ranking before real price data is wired in.

inputs.description: The actual currency/items consumed, for display purposes.

see_also.description: IDs of related or complementary techniques.
